messages:
nina_fin: quick note  saw a late-night spike in us-west GPU charges, ~€2.1k above expected. appears tied to fallback from spot -> on-demand around 23:30 UTC.

rafa_platform: confirmed. autoscaler logs show a flurry of preemptions and immediate fallbacks 23:27-23:49. fallback_count=64.

zoe_ml: Those were hyperparam sweep runs from the ranking team; they retried w/o backoff. I asked them to change retry policy to exponential+w/ jitter.

sam_ops: Any customers impacted? billing-bot: do we have affected customer session list?

billing-bot: Exported list: https://internal.tools/exports/2410001234-uswest-preemptions.csv (45 sessions).

nina_fin: Proposed finance approach: for incidents where preemptions>50 within 2h and fallback=true, credit 45% of incremental GPU cost to affected internal teams; platform contingency covers rest. For customer-facing billings, do not credit customers but tag support to notify.

rafa_platform: 45% seems reasonable and nudges teams to fix retries. I approve.

zoe_ml: approve. we'll roll template changes.

sam_ops: approve and will notify affected accounts about impact (no customer credits).

nina_fin: filing adjustment now. billing-bot: open ticket please. Include invoice note: "partial platform credit - spot fallback (US-WEST)"

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-5234 created. Credited €945 (45% of €2.1k). Postmortem draft: https://internal.docs/postmortems/BILL-5234-uswest-fallback.

nina_fin: action items: 1) platform to tune cooldown windows (owner: rafa_platform), 2) eng teams to audit retry settings (owner: zoe_ml), 3) finance to add 45% rule to playbook (owner: nina_fin). Closing once DMs sent. Thanks all :tada:
